ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, fair value (gains) losses on equity and limited partnership investments, impairments and other charges, pension settlement losses, acquisition-related items, product-line disposition gains and contract settlement expense, then deducts the aggregate tax effect and removes discrete tax items. MCPS: per-share adjustments assume all MCPS converted ('if-converted' regardless of dilution); adjusted diluted shares = GAAP diluted shares + converted shares of anti-dilutive MCPS, and the related MCPS dividends are added back. Continuing operations only. Adjusted diluted shares 745.6m (743.1m + 2.5m MCPS B converted shares; Series B converted 17-Apr-2023 at 5.0175 shares each). Separation costs ($101m pretax in 9M per Q3 release) do not appear in the FY continuing-operations bridge. Item amounts from release footnotes.
